scientific_scope.label: ABIDE cross-sectional aggregation and conditioning case study
scientific_scope.paper_relation: Methodological illustration of the distinction between individual and ecological correlations; not a reproduction, age-prediction benchmark, longitudinal maturation claim, or diagnostic contrast.

primary_units.within_site: participant conditional on source-defined site fixed effects

scientific_scope.interpretation: No required sign, ordering, attenuation or significance. SITE_ID combines protocol/scanner/cohort; conditioning does not identify a scanner cause. Model-based analytic uncertainty is neither cluster-robust nor multiplicity-adjusted. The varying available-edge support limits participant comparisons.

source.header: Tab-delimited #1 through #200; preserve every subsequent numeric frame
source.structure: Individual frame counts and column identities are read from each SHA-pinned original, not inferred from population statistics. All original values must be finite. Structural or hash failure is a precondition failure, not QC exclusion.
source.selection: The supplied literal FILE_ID list defines the fixed released-derivative cohort. Keep every participant in the ledger. Join the original full phenotype by exact FILE_ID, source SUB_ID integer identity and recorded original row index; no digit-stripped FILE_ID aliases.
source.preprocessing: Released CPAC band-pass filtered, no-global-signal-regression derivatives. No new filtering, nuisance regression within time series, scrubbing, censoring, resampling, imputation or shrinkage.
source.coverage: Retain all original 200 column identities; only constant/zero-centered-norm columns are inactive. Some participants have fewer than 200 active columns, so available edge sets vary. No additional coverage threshold.

phenotype_normalization.raw_tokens: Preserve original strings including surrounding whitespace and blank/missing markers; normalize separately.
phenotype_normalization.numeric: Strip surrounding whitespace. Blank -> null/missing. Malformed or nonfinite -> null/invalid_numeric.
phenotype_normalization.mean_fd: Finite >=0; negative -> null/invalid_mean_fd. No upper QC cutoff.
phenotype_normalization.sex: Finite integer-valued released codes1 or2; otherwise null/invalid_code. Use the numeric code as the existing adjustment covariate.
phenotype_normalization.dx_group: Finite integer-valued released codes1 or2; otherwise null/invalid_code. typical_control is true exactly for2, false for1, null otherwise.
phenotype_normalization.site: Strip outer whitespace, preserve remaining literal case/content. Blank -> null/missing. Never derive from FILE_ID prefix.
phenotype_normalization.csv_header: A single first empty header may be the documentary index. Other empty or duplicate headers are errors.
phenotype_normalization.no_filename: All77 original unavailable-derivative rows remain in the full1112-row provenance ledger but never enter the fixed1035 analysis cohort.

numerical_kernel.role: Public exact arithmetic contract and optional reusable helper; no I/O, source loading, answer arrays or outcomes. Shared byte-identical private kernel does not constitute an independent solver. Private original source parsing/connectivity is separately reconstructed.
numerical_kernel.api: connectivity(time_by_column); analyze(canonical_rows,accepted_connectivity). Normalized source rows contain subject, connectivity, age, site_id, mean_fd, sex, typical_control.

numerical.sharing: The reviewed kernel may be byte-identically public and private. Independent source parsers and connectivity reconstruction are separate checks; no independent SVD claim.
numerical.canonical_row_order: Sort normalized rows by exact literal subject FILE_ID before all reductions. Source frame order is unchanged. Input row/key permutations do not redefine arithmetic order.

centering.constant: Exactly equal entries -> literal zero centered vector.
centering.normal: Subtract first entry as anchor, then subtract math.fsum(anchor differences)/n. This removes a large common level before reduction/projection.
centering.overflow_fallback: If anchor differences overflow, divide original vector by maxabs and center there; Pearson uses this scaled representation directly. If only the sum over finite anchor differences overflows, accurately sum scaled differences before restoring the mean. Projection requires finite physical-unit centered output.
centering.mean: Exactconstant guard; math.fsum(values)/n, with maxabs scaled fallback only if that sum overflows.

connectivity.finite_policy: Every value in every source column is finite before determining activity.
connectivity.activity: Exactly constant or zero stable centered norm is inactive; no nearconstant magnitude threshold.
connectivity.covariance: Normalize each accurately centered active column by its stable L2 norm before C-float64 matrix product Z.T@Z; original order retained.
connectivity.edges: Every strict-upper pair among that participant's available nonconstant columns once; coverage may vary by participant and must be disclosed. No new coverage QC cutoff, diagonal, absolute value, shrinkage or preprocessing.
connectivity.undefined: Fewer than two active columns -> null participant connectivity, all identities retained.
connectivity.serialized_domain: Participant receipt only: abs(value)<=cap+value_atol+value_rtol*cap; still require every participant source-close and all active-direction fidelity checks. This is not a broader canonical-estimator domain.

tolerances.discrete: Identities, support, rank, df, count, Boolean and status exact. Correlation/CI [-1,1] and probability [0,1] remain strict independently of tolerance.
tolerances.diagnostics: No extra acceptance gate on SVD singulars or added-basis orthogonality. Any future required diagnostic receipt tolerance must be explicitly reviewed.

projection.design: Intercept first; lexical drop-first site indicators; named covariates lexical. Values are canonical source-normalized covariates, not rounded submitted receipts.
projection.operator: C(v)-U_keep@(U_keep.T@C(v)); C is the declared accurate centering, applied before projection.
projection.activity: L2(C(operator(source_vector))) > 1e-12*L2(C(original_source_vector)), with positive original scale required.
projection.fidelity: For each active canonical direction, L2(C(operator(accepted_y))-C(operator(source_y))) <=1e-6*L2(C(operator(source_y))). No absolute floor; canonical inactive stays unavailable even if accepted jitter varies.

pearson.arithmetic: Normalize each accurately centered vector by its stable L2 norm; exact equal/opposite normalized vectors return +/-1; otherwise math.fsum(elementwise product), clipping only <=64eps floating excursions into [-1,1].
pearson.inactive: No epsilon denominator. Return null under canonical source support.
pearson.t: For |r|<1, df>0: r*sqrt(df/(1-r*r)); two-sided t survival p.
pearson.perfect: Signed r retained; df>0 p=0 as the declared limit, t=null/infinite_t; Fisher CI=null/perfect_correlation. Nonpositive df retains null p.
pearson.small_sample: A defined r is retained even when p or CI is unavailable; separate field statuses.

quadratic.age: Canonical source age centered and standardized by stable population SD on base sample; constant age unavailable.
quadratic.base: X0=[intercept,az], canonical gesvd rank q0 and R0 as above.
quadratic.added: q=az*az; h=R0(R0(q)); add=1 iff L2(h)>max(n,3)*eps64*L2(q); q1=q0+add. No independent X1 SVD rank decision.
quadratic.operator: When add=1, u=h/L2(h); e0=R0(y); a=fsum(u*e0); R1(y)=e0-u*a. Exactly the same R1 defines canonical source denominator support, accepted fidelity and E.
quadratic.gain_and_error: G=a*a; E=fsum(R1(y)**2); no subtraction of independently rounded RSS receipts.
quadratic.beta: a/L2(h) if add=1, null otherwise. No second X1 coefficient solve.
quadratic.F: G/df1 divided by E/df2, if added/residual df and canonical denominator support valid. G=0,E>0 ->F=0,p=1.
quadratic.undefined: No added rank, nonpositive residual df, or inactive canonical full-model residual ->null F/p with distinct status. Supported unsquared residual norm but squared E or E/df2 underflow ->numerical_underflow/null F/p; nonzero a with a*a underflow likewise. Positive G whose final F quotient rounds to zero is also numerical_underflow. Never relabel underflow as the exact G0/F0/p1 case. No epsilon denominator; overflow explicitly unavailable.
quadratic.diagnostic_only: max(abs(U0.T@u)) does not define another rank or acceptance threshold.

sample_lineage.base: Defined source connectivity plus source-normalized age with 0<age<120. Every fixed source participant stays in the ledger.
sample_lineage.site_parent: Base participants with a source-valid site having at least five base members.
sample_lineage.motion: Site-parent complete for normalized mean_fd; no site-threshold reapplication.
sample_lineage.sex: Site-parent complete for normalized sex; no assumed original coding here.
sample_lineage.diagnosis: Site-parent whose upstream normalized typical_control flag is true; no assumed original code here.
sample_lineage.per_site: Every site in the frozen eligible site-parent set, including undefined correlation/slope rows.
sample_lineage.size_guards: No undocumented >50 requirement; mathematical rank/support/df only.
sample_lineage.summaries: Per-site correlation median/min/max/sign fraction requires nonempty complete eligible-site support; otherwise null with expected/defined counts. Equal-site ecological correlation is not participant-size weighted.

numerical.authority: Canonical source support/covariates/designs/sample membership, followed by exactly one accepted participant connectivity replay. No canonical r/p/F/sign/ordering target; reported intermediate receipts do not drive later arithmetic.
fidelity_directions: Each eligible site's centered participant y
Quadratic R0(y) and the exact nested R1(y), when canonical active

failure: Any original hash/shape/nonfinite failure: nonzero exit, failure_report.json with status failed_precondition and nonempty reason. An undefined statistical quantity instead remains null with its declared status and sample identities.
